embeds.title: 🚀 TSHU SMP · WE ARE GOING LIVE!
embeds.description:
The wait is **over**. The biggest update in TSHU SMP history launches the second **Tshu** hits **Go Live**, and you can watch it all happen with the whole community! 🔥

📺 **Watch the launch:** https://www.twitch.tv/tshu

Teams, bounties, duels, a shady black market and so much more. Here is everything waiting for you. 👇

embeds.title: 👥 Teams · Build Your Empire
embeds.description:
Gather your crew and make it official!

**Team Chat:** talk privately with your team in your own chat.
**Richest Team:** a leaderboard shows which team has the biggest bank. Be #1.
**⭐ Team Tags (the big one):** every team member gets a **custom tag above their name** that shows everyone who you roll with.

**Cost to create a team: $25,000**
Make it count.

embeds.title: 💰 Bounties · Put a Price on Their Head
embeds.description:
Got a rival? Make them pay.

**1.** Any player can place **any amount** on another player's head
**2.** Bounties stack as more players add to the pot
**3.** The player who **kills the target takes the entire bounty**

Hunt or be hunted. 🎯

embeds.title: ⚔️ Duels · Prove Yourself
embeds.description:
Two ways to fight:

🏆 **Ranked:** `/duelq`
Join the queue. High stakes: you **don't keep your inventory** and your **stats are recorded**.

🛡️ **Practice:** `/duelpractice`
Sharpen your skills. You **keep your inventory** and **no stats are recorded**.

Train in practice, then climb the ranks.

embeds.title: 🕶️ Black Market · Trust No One
embeds.description:
Deep in the shadows, a dealer is waiting.

**New items every day** at great prices
**Limited stock.** When it's gone, it's gone
**Careful...** the shady dealer might just **scam you**. Are you feeling lucky?

embeds.title: 📈 Item of the Day · Price Boosted
embeds.description:
Every day, **one item gets a huge sell boost**.

Time to **dust off your old farms** and get them ready. The right item could make you rich overnight. 🤑

embeds.title: 🔧 Also Enhanced
embeds.description:
`~` **New Spawn:** a fresh start for every player
`~` **Bedrock Quality of Life:** smoother play for our Bedrock family
`~` **Crates:** overhauled and better than ever
`~` **Menu UI:** a cleaner, sleeker interface
